q: Melnikov's method detects transverse homoclinic intersections (and hence chaos via Smale-Birkhoff theorem) in near-integrable systems by computing:
opts: An integral measuring the separation between stable and unstable manifolds
exp: Melnikov's function M(t₀) = ∫ f ∧ g dt (wedge product of unperturbed and perturbation vector fields) measures the signed distance between the perturbed stable and unstable manifolds. A simple zero gives a transverse crossing.
